description: Spectrum DCT38M-SDM 38" Side Discharge and Mulch Lawn Tractor with Manual Drive
marketingText: Cut large lawns in a fraction of the time from the comfort of a ride-on seat. The DCT38M-SDM clears a 38-inch swathe each pass, and its twin blades leave an even finish whether you bag, mulch or side-discharge. Seven cutting heights set from a single lever, so you adjust on the move.
productFeatures1: 38-inch twin-blade deck clears wide passes in fewer laps
productFeatures2: Seven cutting heights set from one lever
productFeatures3: Bag, mulch or side-discharge from the seat
